A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the anaerobic sequencing batch reactors (ASBR) are an effective treatment system for the removal of COD, BOD5 and N02 -N in abattoir wastewater with the added benefit of reducing the organic carbon requirement for denitrification in the aerobic sequencing batch reactor (ASBR).

The main takeaway from our work is that
the anaerobic sequencing batch reactors (ASBRs) can be used to treat meat processing wastewater and to provide organic carbon for denitrification in a single system.
the organic carbon in effluents from anaerobic SBr can be used as carbon source for denitfication.
the organic matter in the anaerobic effluent from SBR can be successfully used as an alternative source of organic carbon in the anoxic SBR for the removal of nitrates.
